description: phi -> K+K- helicity amplitudes (Diehl notation, T and U, nucleon non-flip) plus the K+K- S-wave, extracted from CLAS12 RGA/RGK data (6.535, 7.546, 10.6 GeV) by the per-bin unbinned likelihood fit with the 7-D acceptance.
content: 17 (Q2, xB, |t|) nodes x 22 parameters (16 P-wave + 6 S-wave); |A|^2 = 5-term smooth model in (log Q2, log xB, |t|) times per-node rate calibration; amplitude direction interpolated linearly between nodes
helicity_convention: RGA (RGK beam helicity flipped to RGA before the fit)
validation: data/eta vs this generator inside the CLAS12 fiducial region: fiducial yield ratio 1.06/1.06/1.04 per beam; BSA in Phi chi2 4.3/6, phi_H 5.4/8 (vecmeson_extraction FINDINGS 2026-11-05)
